entities.summary: Joel Michael Bitonio is an American professional football guard. He played college football for the Nevada Wolf Pack and was selected by the Cleveland Browns in the second round of the 2014 NFL draft. During his NFL career, Bitonio has been named to seven Pro Bowls, two first-team and three second-team All-Pro teams.
